title: Composition preserves local finite presentation
statement: Let $U,X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $a:U\to X$ and $f:X\to S$ be morphisms locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Then $f\circ a:U\to S$ is locally of finite presentation.
